title: Hold a firearms dealer licence
what: Deal in firearms or sell ammunition in trade only under a firearms dealer licence from the Commissioner of Police.

sources.title: Firearms Act 1997 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not possess or use a firearm unless the person is authorised to do so by a licence or permit

sources.title: Firearms Act 1997 (NT)
sources.quote: A firearms dealer licence authorises the holder to possess, use and deal in only firearms of a category specified in the licence

sources.title: Firearms Act 1997 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not, in trade or commerce, sell ammunition for a firearm unless the person is the holder of a firearms dealer licence

sources.title: Firearms Act 1997 (NT)
sources.locator: s 10AB, words naming the body (found 23 Nov 2026) (current reprint)
sources.quote: The Commissioner must not grant a firearms dealer licence if the Commissioner: (a) is of the view that a person who (in the opinion of the Commissioner) is or will be a close associate of the applicant is not a fit and proper person to be a close associate of the holder of a firearms dealer licence;
